problems.issue: Precision nit in the reflection inventory: only the two constructors, `transform` and `transformInverse` are resolved on `dev.ryanhcode.sable.companion.math.BoundingBox3d` (SableReflectionApi lines 159-160, 166-167). `toMojang` and the six `minX`…`maxZ` accessors are resolved on the interface `BoundingBox3dc` (lines 168-174), and a fourth class, `Pose3dc`, is looked up as the parameter type. The methods do exist on `BoundingBox3d` (it implements the interface, otherwise the invocations would fail), so nothing stated is false — but the row above it says a renamed class or method degrades to main-level-only, and a reader chasing that would look in the wrong class.
problems.correction: e.g. "…`BoundingBox3d`'s two constructors plus `transform`/`transformInverse`, and `BoundingBox3dc`'s `toMojang` and six `minX`…`maxZ` accessors (with `Pose3dc` resolved as the parameter type)."
